comparison.objective: Load exactly three plates into a rated rack and divert two to an overflow tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Counting, plate placement, and load-distribution compliance versus fine adjustment and physical response testing.
comparison.success_condition: Never place a fourth plate on the rack; finish with three in rack and two in tray versus two safe carriage-stop cycles.
comparison.reason: Both impose safety limits, but plate-count capacity compliance is unrelated to adjusting and locking a damper. No spec versions or detailed placement thresholds are available.
